user.title: Connect Hermes
user.description: Connection details for the Hermes Gateway API server. Add multiple entries for different profiles.

data_description.host: The IP of the server running the Hermes gateway.
data_description.profile: Which Hermes profile to use (e.g. default).
data_description.model: Model override, e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash. Empty = server default.
data_description.provider: Provider for the model, e.g. openrouter. Empty = server default.
data_description.use_ssl: Enable when the gateway is reachable behind an HTTPS reverse proxy with a valid certificate.
data_description.ssl_cert_path: Path to a CA file that signed the gateway certificate (cert pinning for self-signed). Empty = system CA store.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hermes
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for the Hermes Gateway API server.

data_description.use_ssl: Enable when the gateway is reachable behind an HTTPS reverse proxy with a valid certificate.
data_description.ssl_cert_path: Path to a CA file that signed the gateway certificate (cert pinning for self-signed). Empty = system CA store.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Hermes server.
error.invalid_cert: Certificate could not be loaded (check the path).

abort.already_configured: This profile is already configured on this server.

data_description.model: e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash. Leave empty for server default.
data_description.provider: e.g. openrouter. Leave empty for server default.
data_description.prefer_local_intents: When on, simple commands and status questions Home Assistant understands by itself (lights, covers, switches, state queries — by name and alias) are answered by Home Assistant directly (milliseconds, no model call). Everything else still goes to Hermes. Off = every request goes to Hermes.
